notes.title: Operation F.A.T.E. Has Released!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Intro[/b][/h1]
Thank you all for your patience! Operation F.A.T.E....is finally a complete game!

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
Now you can experience all the game has to offer...and more:

[list]
[*]Randomly generated mystery, with a different solution everytime (not included in the Early Access).
The number of clues you need to solve the mystery changes on each playthrough, as well as the solution to the mystery of course.
[*]Randomly generated levels, with enhanced tweaking.
[*]Randomly generated bosses (no two bosses are the exact same in both look and functionality).
[*]Randomly generated dialogue + options. Remember; your choices may affect certain parts of, or the overall story, so you need to choose both your actions and words carefully!
[*]Inventory management. There are now a lot more variety of items/materials to handle, and limited space in the inventory.
[*]Enriched character development. There are 'dating sim' elements but the game in its essence is not a dating sim.
[*]The list goes on...
[/list]


[h1][b]Credits[/b][/h1]
Special thanks to Linus Jusman (my brother), and Shaun Adams (my best friend) for being the most supportive kind of people on the planet of Earth (and for debugging my game). And of course a warm hug to the rest of my family and friends. You are the people who have encouraged me to become the person I am today.


...And thank YOU for being a supporter of this game. Let's save the Earth - [i]together[/i]!

notes.title: Infinite Anime Chat System (Spoilers!)
notes.notes:
It has been coded! 

Featuring a chatting system where players can talk to the NPC for endless (infinite) possibilities of responses available, much like talking in real life. Don't believe it? Take a look at the trailer below for actual gameplay "proof of concept" (not really proof, but a gameplay preview). 

There may be improvements to the speech for the future, but no promises.
